summary: Ceragon Networks filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 third-quarter earnings release (Exhibit A), signed by CFO Ronen Stein on November 5, 2026. Revenue rose 11.7% year over year to $95.5 million, GAAP operating income was $4.5 million, GAAP net income $2.4 million ($0.03 per diluted share), non-GAAP EPS $0.07, and cash from operations reached $14.1 million, with cash of $39.1 million. Management updated 2026 revenue guidance to $365–375 million. The filing is a routine quarterly results disclosure, not a special situation.
